headline: Enphase Energy (ENPH) Unveils Kestrel ASIC White Paper For Its Next Energy Products
summary: Enphase Energy released a new technical white paper on its Kestrel ASIC, a fifth generation custom silicon platform for its smart energy products. The Kestrel chip is designed to manage power conversion and control functions across microinverters, batteries, EV chargers, and solid state transformers.
